item.title: Threads posts can now be shared directly to your Instagram Story without leaving the app
item.description: The new Threads feature lets you share your posts — or anyone else's — to your Instagram Story without leaving the Threads app.

item.title: Tesla loses bid to overturn $243M Autopilot verdict
item.description: "The grounds for relief that Tesla relies upon are virtually the same as those Tesla put forth previously during the course of trial."

item.title: Ukrainian man jailed for identity theft that helped North Koreans get jobs at US companies
item.description: A Ukrainian man has been sentenced for helping North Koreans gain fraudulent employment at dozens of U.S. companies and funnel that money back to the regime to fund its nuclear weapons program.

item.title: Great news for xAI: Grok is now pretty good at answering questions about Baldur’s Gate
item.description: A new report from Business Insider reveals that high-level engineers at xAI were pulled off other projects to make sure Grok could answer detailed questions about the video game Baldur's Gate.

item.title: InScope nabs $14.5M to solve the pain of financial reporting
item.description: The startup, founded by accountants who worked at Flexport, Miro, Hopin and Thrive Global, automates the difficulties of prepping financial statements.

item.title: Apple’s iOS 26.4 arrives in public beta with AI music playlists, video podcasts, and more
item.description: Several updates are introduced in iOS 26.4, including an AI-powered playlist-generation feature in Apple Music, support for video content in the Podcasts app, end-to-end encryption (E2EE) for RCS messages, and more.

item.title: Anthropic-funded group backs candidate attacked by rival AI super PAC
item.description: Dueling pro-AI PACs have centered around backing or targeting one New York congressional bid: Alex Bores, whose RAISE Act requires AI developers to disclose safety protocols and report serious system misuse.

item.title: Remember HQ? ‘Quiz Daddy’ Scott Rogowsky is back with TextSavvy, a daily mobile game show
item.description: The former HQ host Scott Rogowsky is back with TextSavvy, a live mobile game show that he's building on his own terms.

item.title: The creator economy’s ad revenue problem and India’s AI ambitions
item.description: The creator economy is evolving fast, and ad revenue alone isn’t cutting it anymore. YouTubers are launching product lines, acquiring startups, and building actual business empires. In fact, MrBeast’s company bought fintech startup Step, and his chocolate business is outearning his media arm. This isn’t just one creator’s strategy. For many, it’s the new playbook.
